title: Tokyo Skytree
summary: Tokyo Skytree is a broadcasting tower in Sumida ward, Tokyo, 634 m tall, with a triangular base about 68 m on a side. The project began in 2006, construction finished on 29 February 2012, and it opened to visitors on 22 May 2012. The operator says it was built as the world's tallest free-standing broadcasting tower.
